subject: Mobile Development
title: The App Store Changes Software Forever
description: A quick win: understand The App Store Changes Software Forever.

hook.text: Before 2008, installing software on a phone meant navigating carrier portals and paying fees.

buildup.text: Apple's App Store let anyone browse, buy, and install apps with a single tap.

discovery.text: Developers could reach millions of users without needing carrier deals or retail shelf space.

twist.text: Apple's 30% revenue cut sparked lawsuits and antitrust investigations worldwide.

climax.text: The App Store model was copied by Google, Amazon, and every platform that followed.

punchline.text: One store replaced every software retailer.

quiz.question: What percentage does Apple take from App Store sales?
